title: Convergent Form, Divergent Voice II — Corpus
description: Research corpus of freeflow and values probes with explicit deployment provenance. Version 1.2.50 adds 245 revision-pinned Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct BF16 Colab/vLLM traces. Release candidate only; no new DOI is claimed. Summary: 68,157 valid samples, 596 probe cells, 198 model labels; the Colab label is counted separately from historical Qwen2.5-32B labels.
